title: The ledger itself refuses an overspend when the policy is bypassed
proves: Even if every app-level check is skipped and the agent tries to pay an attacker 50 RLUSD, the XRPL ledger rejects it, because the agent wallet never holds more than its small allowance.
cost: a tiny XRP fee (the rejected payment still reaches the ledger)
summary: Rejected by the ledger with tecPATH_PARTIAL.

actual.error: ledger rejected the payment with tecPATH_PARTIAL

assertions.description: the reason is the ledger rejecting it
the ledger result is a "tec" rejection code

evidence.attempt: 50 RLUSD from the agent wallet to the attacker wallet, sent straight to the payment layer

result.error: ledger rejected the payment with tecPATH_PARTIAL
